items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
items.description: The recordings appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
items.description: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.

items.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
items.description: With 93% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 13, officials say
items.description: Dnipro regional head Oleksandr Hanzha said at least 10 others were wounded in the attack, including an 11-year-old boy.

items.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
items.description: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan Markle's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

items.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
items.description: One of the regions famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

items.title: Carney to push for closer ties at Canada-EU summit in Montreal
items.description: The term "associate member" is reportedly off the table as officials discuss deeper economic and defence ties.

items.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering
items.description: Xi's anti-corruption campaign has become "an effort to consolidate and maintain authority", observers say.

items.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
items.description: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.

items.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
items.description: The Republican governor was responding to allegations in the New York Times that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate, Dan Sullivan.

items.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
items.description: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.

items.title: US sanctions Rwanda's defence ministry over DR Congo conflict
items.description: Congo accuses Rwanda of backing M23 rebels and plundering minerals in its conflict hit East
